blocks.text: Waterfall Model software banane ka ek seedha tareeqa hai jis mein project ki har phase agli phase shuru hone se pehle mukammal honi chahiye. Ise waterfall (aabshar / jharna) samjhein jis ka paani ek level se agle level par girta hai. Yeh model linear aur sequential (seedhi line mein, ek ke baad ek) hai: aap har phase se order mein guzarte hain aur mukammal ho chuki phase par wapas nahi jate, jaisa Figure 1.2 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Waterfall Model ki main phases yeh hain:

items: Requirements: software ko kya karna hai, yeh jama karna aur likhna.
Design: plan karna ke software kaise banega aur kaisa dikhega.
Implementation: software banane ke liye asal code likhna.
Testing: software mein masle ya bugs check kar ke theek karna.
Deployment: software users ke istemal ke liye jaari (release) karna.
Maintenance: software istemal mein aane ke baad updates karna aur naye masle theek karna.
Saada aur samajhne mein aasan: is ki phases saaf aur alag alag hain, is liye is par chalna aasan hai.
Sequential process: har phase ek waqt mein ek mukammal hoti hai, is liye kaam sambhalna aur progress dekhna aasan hai.
Chhote projects ke liye suitable (munasib): un projects ke liye acha hai jin ki requirements saaf aur pakki hon aur tabdeeli ka chance kam ho.
Inflexibility (lachak na hona): phase mukammal hone ke baad wapas ja kar tabdeeli karna mushkil aur mehnga hai.
Complex projects ke liye theek nahi: jin projects ki requirements badalti rehti hon ya design complex (mushkil) ho, un mein yeh model achi tarah chalana mushkil hai.
Risk and Uncertainty (khatra aur pakka pata na hona): yeh model farz karta hai ke saari requirements shuru se maloom hain; agar baad mein nayi zaroorat ya masla aaye to nuqsan ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Limitations ki list mein number 3 khali chhapa hai aur 'Risk and Uncertainty' number 4 par hai. Yahan teen limitations hain; koi bhi baat chhooti nahi.

blocks.alt: Waterfall (Plan Driven) ke title ke neeche saat gehre neele teer baen se daen neeche utarte hain: Requirements, Analysis, Design, Implementation, Testing, Delivery aur Maintenance. Teeron ke neeche kaamon ki chhoti lists hain aur sab se neeche Project Timeline ka lamba teer hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.2: Waterfall Model (kitab ki Figure 1.2 ke mutabiq apni banayi hui drawing).
blocks.long_description: Phases ke neeche chhape kaam: Requirements: project ka scope (daira) tay karna, stakeholders se interview, user research, requirements jama karna, kick-off meeting. Design: high-level design, design review, design mein tabdeeliyan, stakeholder ki manzoori. Implementation: dev phase 1, review, dev phase 2, review. Testing: testing, tabdeeliyan. Delivery: deployment.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer sirf aage aur neeche jate hain, koi teer wapas oopar nahi jata: har phase mukammal ho kar hi agli shuru hoti hai, jaise waterfall ka pani sirf neeche girta hai. Neeche ka Project Timeline teer waqt (time) dikhata hai, yani Requirements sab se pehle aur Maintenance sab se aakhir mein aata hai. Figure ki 'Delivery' phase wohi hai jise upar deployment kaha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Jis project ki requirements badalne ka chance ho, us ke liye Waterfall Model khatarnak kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh farz karta hai ke saari requirements shuru mein maloom hain aur mukammal phase par wapas nahi jata. Baad mein aane wali tabdeeli ke liye design, code aur tests dobara karne parte hain jo mushkil aur mehnga hai. Yeh saaf aur pakki requirements wale chhote projects ke liye munasib hai.

items: Waterfall: linear aur sequential phases (requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, maintenance); wapas nahi jate (Fig. 1.2).
Benefits: saada, progress dekhna aasan, chhote pakke projects ke liye acha; limitations: lachak nahi, complex projects ke liye mushkil, risk.
